items.title: Crypto traders vs. Wall Street: OKX’s Anthropic markets put IPO pricing to the test
items.summary: The crypto exchange plans to launch tokenized Anthropic shares as its pre-IPO futures trade about 24% above the company’s $83 offering price.

items.title: Trump Media wants to clear $884 million of debt without selling its bitcoin
items.summary: The Truth Social owner bought back $100 million of convertible notes this week. Holders of the rest can demand cash on Nov. 30, and its bitcoin is worth just under $1 billion.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF outflows show waning crypto appetite ahead of Anthropic's Nasdaq debut
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 19, 2026

items.title: Bitcoin holds above $63,750 but Fed rate-hike threats loom large
items.summary: Bitcoin ETFs saw more than $300 million in outflows Wednesday, with attention now turning to Anthrophic's $100 billion IPO.

items.title: North Korean hackers used Sky's stablecoin system, putting billions at freeze risk
items.summary: Blockchain investigation traced $518 million in illicit-linked activity, including the 2025 Bybit hack, through a key reserve backing DAI and USDS tokens, putting Sky's institutional finance ambitions and open design on

items.title: Anthropic’s $107 billion sale set to top SpaceX’s IPO as tokenized stocks gain traction
items.summary: The maker of Claude priced its Nasdaq debut at $83 a share for a $1.5 trillion fully diluted valuation, with the Nasdaq 100 down 14% from record highs.

items.title: Financial firms must act now as quantum computers grow ‘highly advanced,’ IOSCO warns
items.summary: No quantum computer can yet break widely used cryptography, but the securities watchdog says banks and blockchains face a yearslong security overhaul that many have barely begun.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin nears $64,000 as Anthropic’s record IPO lifts tech
items.summary: The Nasdaq was higher by about 2% early Thursday. One analyst said IPO money could flow back into crypto.

items.title: Singapore settles $77.5 million tokenized bill sale in local CBDC
items.summary: The central bank aims to expand this digital settlement network and test wider collateral use in 2027.

items.title: Roundhill scraps Solana and XRP income ETFs as rival funds indicate low demand
items.summary: Roundhill withdrew plans for two funds designed to generate income from SOL and XRP, highlighting the gap between billions invested in spot crypto ETFs and limited demand for more specialized strategies.

items.title: Anthropic shares expected to open at $110, 32.5% above $83 IPO price
items.summary: The AI giant’s $81.3 billion offering at an expected $110 per share would value the company at north of $2 trillion.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Ethereum’s new DeFi security tool raises questions over censorship
items.summary: Phylax’s system lets decentralized protocols block potentially harmful transactions, but raises questions about potential censorship and Ethereum’s concentrated builder market.

items.title: Hong Kong adds Hyperliquid to list of ‘suspicious’ crypto platforms
items.summary: Hong Kong’s securities regulator said Hyperliquid has no local license and may have promoted its trading services to investors in the city.

items.title: GTA VI publisher racks up nearly 3x Nvidia’s tokenized stock volume
items.summary: Tokenized Take-Two shares drew $249.5 million in DEX volume Wednesday, nearly three times the $88.1 million for tokenized Nvidia shares.

items.title: Sweden’s H100 could tap Bitcoin trading pool to fund share buybacks
items.summary: Shareholders will vote Dec. 7 on whether H100 can buy back up to 10% of its shares, potentially using a Bitcoin pool that lost about 30 BTC in Q3.

items.title: IOSCO warns quantum upgrades could slow blockchains, leave security gaps
items.summary: A Solana test network ran about 90% slower with quantum-resistant signatures, and wallets that keep using older keys could remain vulnerable.

items.title: Singapore settles $77.5M tokenized bill sale with wholesale CBDC
items.summary: MAS issued the bills directly on its test network, which it plans to rename SG Digital Ledger and use for settlement beyond the trials.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF assets fall to three-month low as 2026 net outflows top $2.5B
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $306.4 million Wednesday, pushing their combined assets to $77.7 billion as Bitcoin briefly traded below $63,000.

items.title: BTCPay Server issues emergency update for 5 security flaws
items.summary: The EU’s cybersecurity service said the flaws could let attackers to run malicious code remotely on vulnerable servers without logging in.

items.title: Anthropic Stock Indicated to Open 33% Above IPO Price as AI Stocks Rally
items.summary: The Claude maker's shares could debut at $110, pushing its valuation toward $2 trillion as enthusiasm for its historic IPO lifts the broader technology sector.

items.title: Anthropic Tops SpaceX's Initial IPO With $81 Billion Deal: Where the Money Went
items.summary: The Claude maker beat SpaceX's original share sale, though not its expanded final IPO. Here's who got the money and why the computing bill could be even bigger.

items.title: Gen Z Embraces Crypto While Most Americans Call It a 'Side Quest'
items.summary: A SoFi and YouGov survey found that 21% of Gen Z adults own crypto, more than hold employer retirement plans, even as only 13% of all Americans own it and most remain skeptical.

items.title: Quantum Upgrade Could Be 'Particularly Challenging' for Blockchains: IOSCO
items.summary: The global securities watchdog said markets shouldn't wait for quantum computers to arrive, flagging bulkier signatures and harder upgrades.

items.title: Morning Minute: Google’s Newest AI Model Tops Benchmarks Ahead of Anthropic IPO
items.summary: Anthropic bulls seem to be shrugging off the news, as ANT pops 25% over IPO price on Hyperliquid pre-debut.

items.title: Binance Wins $6.5B Freezing Order Over Hack That Can Be Served via the Blockchain
items.summary: An Abu Dhabi court's worldwide injunction targets the unknown hackers, backed by a "living list" of 26,000 wallets holding stolen funds.

items.title: GameStop CEO Says Digital-Only Games Have ‘Hurt Consumers’ as GTA 6 Skips Discs
items.summary: Ryan Cohen said publishers are cutting out trade-ins, as he backs a U.S. bill that would guarantee gamers keep access to games they buy.

items.title: Bitcoin Struggles to Hold $64,000 as ETF Outflows Hit $2.9B in November
items.summary: Bitcoin is down 13% in a week as investors pull money from spot ETFs and brace for another Federal Reserve rate hike.

items.title: Ledger Confirms Tampered Bitcoin Wallets in Berlin as Spy Implant Probe Spreads Beyond Asia
items.summary: Ledger says its hardware implant investigation has confirmed tampered devices in Berlin and is examining two suspected units in Dubai, as the incident spreads beyond Southeast Asia.

items.title: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok Helped Plan Terror Attacks in Government Tests
items.summary: Federal investigators bypassed safeguards on four popular chatbots, producing viable attack plans within hours.
